source_title: The Role of Home Environment in Environmental Protection
article_summary: The article emphasizes that household habits, family norms, education, and resource accessibility shape environmentally responsible behavior at home. It highlights energy conservation through turning off lights and electronics, using LED lighting and energy-efficient appliances, and reducing water waste through water-saving fixtures and rainwater conservation. It also supports sustainability awareness, recycling, waste reduction, and the use of smart technologies such as smart thermostats or water-saving devices as ways to reduce household environmental impact.
